image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a large, beige-to-pale-orange coral fungus (Ramaria or similar genus) growing on a forest floor. The fungus features a dense, complex structure of upright, cylindrical branches that divide repeatedly into finer tips. The texture appears smooth with a matte finish. The background consists of dark soil, decaying leaves, and patches of green moss, providing natural contrast.
